360-1981-2415-2921.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
360-1981-2415-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2511-2738-4871-5075.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Ogre Slumlord, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3542-4663.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{U}{U}.
3542-4663.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters, it and Bramble Sovereign trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{U}{U}.
Resolve the Bramble Sovereign trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Palinchron.
When the token Palinchron enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the nontoken Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5147-7084-7892.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

864-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Eternal Witness.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Eternal Witness from exile to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

849-1263-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1753-3259-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
1753-3259-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1753-3259-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

2741-2919-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-2919-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1478-2523-2869.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Sakura-Tribe Elder that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Sakura-Tribe Elder ability.
Repeat using the Sakura-Tribe Elder token

206-2539-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
206-2539-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

4605-5256-6132-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

372-6991-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-6991-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-3480-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

719-5231-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
719-5231-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

147-5256-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-6968.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

3440-4867-5147-6809.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice and Scion of Opulence triggers once.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the first Cormela trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Cormela trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 3.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1323-3291-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Karametra's Acolyte's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

198-2187-4067-6281.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Possessed Skaab.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Possessed Skaab that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

2707-5645-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

38-659-6410.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-6410.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

856-2511-4321-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2511-4321-6351.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

3470-5702-5954-6441.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3470-5702-5954-6441.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3470-5702-5954-6441.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra each trigger twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

56-2523-4054-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-2523-4054-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
56-2523-4054-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

856-2921-4321-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2921-4321-5477.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 green Plant creature token and a Food artifact token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2808-4615.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Enduring Scalelord.
2808-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Enduring Scalelord.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Enduring Scalelord.
The Enduring Scalelord who didn't have the counter put on it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat step 3.

262-2617.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Midnight Guard.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
262-2617.description:
Activate Midnight Guard by tapping it, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Midnight Guard triggers twice, untapping itself.
Repeat.
